description: Branch protection for the default branch, applied by `pnpm repo:host`. `ruleset` is the verbatim body of POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets; nothing else in this file is sent.

requiresAdvancedSecurity.reason: Code scanning and the dependency graph need a public repository or GitHub Advanced Security. On a private repository without either, these jobs cannot report at all, and a required check that never reports blocks every pull request forever. `pnpm repo:host --code-scanning` adds them once one of those holds.
